title: One-story house with a bedroom addition and remodel
source: Approved permit set: proposed floor plan, roof plan, elevations and section (1/4 inch = 1 foot).

openings.tag: pocket door to the walk-in closet

gableRoof.note: Read off the proposed roof plan and elevations: 6:12 gables and hips, a 4 5/32:12 hip over the addition, ridge 18'-8 1/4" above the floor.

stages.label: House
stages.line: The house after the work: a one-story home with a new bedroom filled in between its two west wings under a low hip, gables on the wings and a gabled main block. Seen from the southwest, where the addition is. Choose Explore to turn the model or go to a room.

stages.label: Entry side
stages.line: The entry side: the front door on its stoop with steps down beside the wall, the office and living room windows and the roof sloping down to the entry wall.

stages.label: Roof
stages.line: The roof lifts away. It follows the roof plan: 6:12 gables and hips with a 4 5/32:12 hip over the addition, the ridge 18'-8 1/4" above the floor.

stages.label: Floor plan
stages.line: The floor plan: the new bedroom and hall, the remodeled primary bedroom, baths, walk-in closet and kitchen opened to the family room, plus the office, utility room, pantry and living room.

stages.label: Rooms
stages.line: The plan cut flat with every room name from the drawings. The 265 SF addition is the bedroom and hall between the two west wings.

stages.label: Floor
stages.line: The floor the house stands on, about two feet above the ground over a crawl space.

sheetLabel: Static plan of a one-story house with a bedroom addition between its two west wings.
